title: Index fictional family-case exhibit records

parent.objective: Demonstrate a reproducible source inventory using fictional family-case records.
parent.milestone: Create a complete exhibit index with traceable source identifiers.

goal: Build a stable exhibit index from three synthetic record descriptors without making legal or factual findings.
non_goals: Advise on rights, remedies, deadlines, or admissibility.
File, send, or change any case record.

allowed: Index the three embedded synthetic descriptors.
Check uniqueness, count, order, and source traceability.
prohibited: Introduce real people, cases, court orders, or legal authorities.
Rewrite source descriptors or infer facts beyond their labels.

inputs.name: Synthetic record manifest
inputs.description: FAM-SYN-001: fictional meeting note; FAM-SYN-002: fictional inventory list; FAM-SYN-003: fictional scheduling note. These labels carry no substantive case facts.

outputs.name: Exhibit index
outputs.description: Three rows containing source identifier, verbatim label, and stable ascending index number.

outputs.name: Index verification record
outputs.description: Recorded checks of row count, unique identifiers, stable ordering, and exact label preservation.

interface.name: synthetic_exhibit_index
interface.description: Input record descriptors; output index rows with index_number, source_id, and label.

assumptions: All descriptors are invented solely for indexing tests.
The source identifier order determines the index order.

sources.reference: The three fictional descriptors embedded in this contract inputs.
sources.authority: Synthetic fixture manifest only; no legal authority or real case evidence.

acceptance_criteria.description: The index contains exactly one row for each of the three source identifiers.
Each row preserves its input label verbatim and receives a stable ascending index number.

validation.description: Compare index rows with the embedded manifest and repeat the indexing operation to check stability.
evidence_required: Exact-label comparison and repeated-output equality result.

context_scope: This contract and the embedded fictional record manifest.
The derived index and its verification record.
architecture_boundaries: Keep originals distinct from derived index output.
Make no legal determinations and perform no external writes.
